knowledge:
- key_parameters: <x=The input multi-omics data, represented as a list of data.frames/matrices, or a pre-computed moa object ;; sup=Supplementary data representing gene set annotations, formatted as a list of binary matrices matching the order of datasets in x ;; nf=The number of principal components/factors to retain in the analysis ;; proc.row=Preprocessing method for rows, such as "center_ssq1" ;; w.data=Weighting method for datasets, such as "inertia" ;; statis=Logical; if TRUE, STATIS is used for multi-table analysis, otherwise Multiple Factor Analysis (MFA) is used ;; ncomp=Number of latent variables to calculate in mbpca ;; k=Sparsity parameter in mbpca; "all" for no sparsity, or a decimal (e.g., 0.1) to retain a specific percentage of variables with non-zero coefficients ;; method=The multi-block PCA method, typically "globalScore" ;; option=The optimization option for mbpca, typically "lambda1">
- alternatives: <statis=TRUE (STATIS method) vs statis=FALSE (Multiple Factor Analysis, MFA) for multi-table integration. mbpca (Consensus PCA) is preferred for integrative clustering, whereas moa/mogsa is preferred for gene set projection and scoring.>
- when_to_use: <Use when you have multiple high-throughput omics datasets profiling the same set of biological samples and want to perform pathway-level enrichment analysis or identify integrated molecular subtypes.>
- pitfalls: <The number of principal components (nf) must be carefully selected (e.g., via scree plot or elbow test) before running the final gene set projection. Ensure that both the list names and the row/column names of the multi-omics datasets and supplementary annotation matrices are perfectly matched and in the identical order.>

workflows.name: multiple_omics_gene_set_analysis
workflows.intent: Integrate multiple omics datasets and project gene set annotations to calculate gene set scores (GSS), decompose scores across datasets, and identify key gene influencers.
input: NCI60_4arrays.RData (list of data.frames containing multi-platform microarray data)
NCI60_4array_supdata.RData (list of binary matrices representing gene set annotations)
workflows.stages:
1. Load and verify matching dimensions and names of multi-omics data and supplementary gene set data.
2. Run MOGSA in one step using the mogsa function.
3. Extract and visualize the gene set score (GSS) matrix using heatmaps.
4. Identify the most significant gene sets based on p-values.
5. Decompose gene set scores across datasets and identify key gene influencers using decompose.gs.group and GIS.
6. Project gene sets and samples in latent space using plotGS.
7. Alternatively, perform the analysis in two steps by running multivariate analysis with moa first, evaluating eigenvalues, and then running mogsa.
8. Prepare custom gene set data from graphite or MSigDB GMT files using prepGraphite, prepMsigDB, and prepSupMoa.
workflows.code:
library(mogsa)
library(gplots) # used for visulizing heatmap
# loading gene expression data and supplementary data
data(NCI60_4array_supdata)
data(NCI60_4arrays)

sapply(NCI60_4arrays, dim) # check dimensions of expression data
sapply(NCI60_4array_supdata, dim) # check dimensions of supplementary data
# check if the gene expression data and annotation data are mathced in the same order
identical(names(NCI60_4arrays), names(NCI60_4array_supdata)) 
head(rownames(NCI60_4arrays$agilent)) # the type of gene IDs

dataColNames <- lapply(NCI60_4arrays, colnames)
supColNames <- lapply(NCI60_4arrays, colnames)
identical(dataColNames, supColNames)

# define cancer type
cancerType <- as.factor(substr(colnames(NCI60_4arrays$agilent), 1, 2))
# define color code to distinguish cancer types
colcode <- cancerType
levels(colcode) <- c("black", "red", "green", "blue", 
                     "cyan", "brown", "pink", "gray", "orange")
colcode <- as.character(colcode)

mgsa1 <- mogsa(x = NCI60_4arrays, sup=NCI60_4array_supdata, nf=3,
               proc.row = "center_ssq1", w.data = "inertia", statis = TRUE)

eigs <- getmgsa(mgsa1, "partial.eig") # get partial "eigenvalue" for separate data 
barplot(as.matrix(eigs), legend.text = rownames(eigs))

# get the score matrix
scores <- getmgsa(mgsa1, "score")
heatmap.2(scores, trace = "n", scale = "r", Colv = NULL, dendrogram = "row", 
          margins = c(6, 10), ColSideColors=colcode)

p.mat <- getmgsa(mgsa1, "p.val") # get p value matrix
# select gene sets with most signficant GSS scores.
top.gs <- sort(rowSums(p.mat < 0.01), decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]
top.gs.name <- names(top.gs)
top.gs.name
heatmap.2(scores[top.gs.name, ], trace = "n", scale = "r", Colv = NULL, dendrogram = "row",
          margins = c(6, 10), ColSideColors=colcode)

# gene set score decomposition
# we explore two gene sets, the first one
gs1 <- top.gs.name[1] # select the most significant gene set
gs1

# decompose the gene set score over datasets
decompose.gs.group(mgsa1, gs1, group = cancerType) 

gis1 <- GIS(mgsa1, gs1, barcol = gray.colors(4)) # gene influential score
head(gis1) # print top 6 influencers

# the section gene set
gs2 <- "PUJANA_ATM_PCC_NETWORK"
decompose.gs.group(mgsa1, gs2, group = cancerType, x.legend = "topright")
gis2 <- GIS(mgsa1, "PUJANA_ATM_PCC_NETWORK", topN = 6, barcol = gray.colors(4))
gis2

fs <- getmgsa(mgsa1, "fac.scr") # extract the factor scores for cell lines (cell line space)
layout(matrix(1:2, 1, 2))
plot(fs[, 1:2], pch=20, col=colcode, axes = FALSE)
abline(v=0, h=0)
legend("topright", col=unique(colcode), pch=20, legend=unique(cancerType), bty = "n")
plotGS(mgsa1, label.cex = 0.8, center.only = TRUE, topN = 0, label = c(gs1, gs2))

# perform multivariate analysis
ana <- moa(NCI60_4arrays, proc.row = "center_ssq1", w.data = "inertia", statis = TRUE)
slot(ana, "partial.eig")[, 1:6] # extract the eigenvalue
# show the eigenvalues in scree plot:
layout(matrix(1:2, 1, 2)) 
plot(ana, value="eig", type = 2, n=20, main="variance of PCs") # use '?"moa-class"' to check the help manu
plot(ana, value="tau", type = 2, n=20, main="Scaled variance of PCs")

mgsa2 <- mogsa(x = ana, sup=NCI60_4array_supdata, nf=3)
identical(mgsa1, mgsa2) # check if the two methods give the same results

library(graphite)
keggdb <- prepGraphite(db = pathways("hsapiens", "kegg")[1:50], id = "symbol")
keggdb <- lapply(keggdb, function(x) sub("SYMBOL:", "", x))
keggdb[1:2]

dir <- system.file(package = "mogsa")
preGS <- prepMsigDB(file=paste(dir, "/extdata/example_msigdb_data.gmt.gz", sep = ""))

# the prepare
sup_data1 <- prepSupMoa(NCI60_4arrays, geneSets=keggdb, minMatch = 1)
mgsa3 <- mogsa(x = NCI60_4arrays, sup=sup_data1, nf=3,
               proc.row = "center_ssq1", w.data = "inertia", statis = TRUE)

workflows.name: integrative_clustering_mocluster
workflows.intent: Perform integrative clustering of samples across multiple omics datasets using consensus PCA (CPCA) with sparse or non-sparse loadings.
input: NCI60_4arrays.RData (list of data.frames containing multi-platform microarray data)
workflows.stages:
1. Run multi-block PCA (mbpca) with non-sparse loadings (k = "all") to evaluate variance.
2. Perform permutation test (bootMbpca) to determine the number of significant latent variables.
3. Run mbpca with sparse loadings (e.g., k = 0.1) to keep top variables.
4. Extract latent variables (moaScore) and evaluate optimal cluster number using gap statistic (moGap).
5. Perform hierarchical clustering and visualize with heatmaps.
6. Extract key variables with non-zero coefficients (moaCoef).
workflows.code:
library(mogsa)
data(NCI60_4arrays)

sapply(NCI60_4arrays, dim) # check dimensions of expression data

tumorType <- sapply(strsplit(colnames(NCI60_4arrays$agilent), split="\\."), "[", 1)
colcode <- as.factor(tumorType)
levels(colcode) <- c("red", "green", "blue", "cyan", "orange", 
                     "gray25", "brown", "gray75", "pink")
colcode <- as.character(colcode)

moa <- mbpca(NCI60_4arrays, ncomp = 10, k = "all", method = "globalScore", option = "lambda1", 
             center=TRUE, scale=FALSE, moa = TRUE, svd.solver = "fast", maxiter = 1000)
plot(moa, value="eig", type=2)

r <- bootMbpca(moa, mc.cores = 1, B=20, replace = FALSE, resample = "sample")

moas <- mbpca(NCI60_4arrays, ncomp = 3, k = 0.1, method = "globalScore", option = "lambda1", 
              center=TRUE, scale=FALSE, moa = TRUE, svd.solver = "fast", maxiter = 1000)

scr <- moaScore(moa)
scrs <- moaScore(moas)
diag(cor(scr[, 1:3], scrs))

layout(matrix(1:2, 1, 2))
plot(scrs[, 1:2], col=colcode, pch=20)
legend("topright", legend = unique(tumorType), col=unique(colcode), pch=20)
plot(scrs[, 2:3], col=colcode, pch=20)

gap <- moGap(moas, K.max = 12, cluster = "hcl")
layout(matrix(1, 1, 1))
gap$nClust

hcl <- hclust(dist(scrs))
cls <- cutree(hcl, k=4)
clsColor <- as.factor(cls)
levels(clsColor) <- c("red", "blue", "orange", "pink")
clsColor <- as.character((clsColor))

heatmap(t(scrs[hcl$order, ]), ColSideColors = colcode[hcl$order], Rowv = NA, Colv=NA)
heatmap(t(scrs[hcl$order, ]), ColSideColors = clsColor[hcl$order], Rowv = NA, Colv=NA)

genes <- moaCoef(moas)
genes$nonZeroCoef$agilent.V1.neg
